execution_note: Kiro Web Linux sandbox host: every tool call is a fresh sandbox, only /projects/sandbox persists, /run and cgroup are read-only outside a private mount namespace, cgroup2 is threaded with only cpuset/cpu/pids. Agent-run target code goes only through tools/sbx.py, which per call starts a private dockerd (tmpfs /run, ephemeral data root on the call's /tmp, image loaded from a saved tar) and runs one container: --network none, no docker socket, --read-only, audited worktree read-only at /target, writes only to agents/<id>/scratch at /scratch, /dev/shm 16 MiB, --pull never, uid 65534, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, 512 MiB via RLIMIT_DATA (--memory is discarded by this kernel's cgroup), 1 CPU via cpuset (--cpus is unsupported), 64 pids, 32 MiB file size, 120 s, explicit env allowlist, image agentbox-audit-sbx:1. Scratch is a plain directory owned by uid 65534 (no loop devices); size is checked after each agent. Parent-live checks run the audited control plane in-process (loopback TestClient) against a private dockerd with AGENTBOX_CPUS=0 and AGENTBOX_DESKTOP_CPUS=0 because CPU quotas cannot be applied on this host.
